SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id >= 900 AS pseudo, s.store_id=999 AS training, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_rl,
 sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at::DATE) AS load_days
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6

WITH fs AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
  sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id<900) AS fact_stores_all,
  sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id<900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) AS fact_stores_nostaff,
  sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id<=900) AS fact_stores_plus_web,
  sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id=900) AS fact_web,
  sum(round(f.gross_amount/(1+f.vat_rate),2)-f.net_amount) AS gross_net_diff,
  max(abs(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))) AS max_vat_err
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_before, sum(r.returns_net) AS rpt_returns, sum(r.net_sales) AS rpt_net,
  sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) FILTER (WHERE r.store_id=900) AS rpt_web_before, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) FILTER (WHERE r.store_id=999) AS rpt_train, count(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS nstores
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT * FROM fs JOIN rp USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
 sum(r.refund_net) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id<900) AS ret_stores,
 sum(r.refund_net) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id=900) AS ret_web,
 sum(r.refund_net) FILTER (WHERE s.store_id=999) AS ret_train,
 count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) AS n_sl,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL AND r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) AS ret_of_staff_sales,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > f.net_amount + 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_refund
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date=d.calendar_date) AS lines,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date=d.calendar_date AND s.store_id<900) AS stores_net,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date=d.calendar_date AND s.store_id=900) AS web_net,
 (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=900) AS rpt_web,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT s.store_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date=d.calendar_date AND s.store_id<900) AS n_stores
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') ORDER BY d.calendar_date

SELECT 'chan' AS k, CAST(f.channel_id AS VARCHAR) AS a, CAST(s.store_id>=900 AS VARCHAR) AS b, count(*) AS n, sum(net_amount) AS v, CAST(min(f.sale_date) AS VARCHAR) AS c, CAST(max(f.sale_date) AS VARCHAR) AS d
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY ALL

SELECT 'stg_not_in_fact', NULL, NULL, count(*), sum(net_amount), CAST(min(sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR)

SELECT 'stg_not_in_fact_ly', NULL, NULL, count(*), sum(net_amount), CAST(min(sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR)
FROM stg_sales_line_load g WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND g.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)

SELECT 'chan_ly', CAST(f.channel_id AS VARCHAR), f.channel_code, count(*), sum(net_amount), CAST(min(f.sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(f.sale_date) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY ALL

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week
  FROM dim_date d WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
returns AS (
  SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
net AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.returns_net, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       round(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year,
       round(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       round((ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM net ty JOIN net ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
